d:
Divali ke mauke par kendriy mantri dharmendr pradhan ka achanak bihar daura aur mukhyamantri nitish kumar, dipti siem samrat chaudhri va sanjay jha se mulakat rajniti ka naya kendr bindu ban gaee hai. kya bihar endie men sab kuchh thik nahin chal raha tha? emaelsi chunav vivad, dijipi niyukti aur prashasnik pherabdal ko lekar bijepi aur jadyu ke bich barhi tanatni ko mainej karne ke lie kya bijepi aalakman ne dharmendr pradhan ko patna bheja?
Is vidiyo men dekhie:
Kya dharmendr pradhan ne ek bar phir bijepi aur jadyu ke bich sankatmochan (madhyasth) ki bhumika nibhaee hai?
